visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman holding a large grey product box. She has long, dark brown hair, fair skin, and is wearing a simple grey tank top. She smiles at the camera, looking directly at the viewer. Behind her is a softly lit indoor room, appearing to be a living area with neutral-toned furniture. (2) She begins pulling out multiple individually wrapped bagels in white and transparent packaging, holding them up to the camera. Small animated bagel icons float around her head. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the product labels clearly. (3) The shot remains centered on the woman as she uses her hands to gesture towards the bagels. She holds her smartphone in one hand, showing a screen with nutritional data, while the other hand holds several bagel packs. White and yellow text overlays appear on the bottom and sides of the frame. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands as she holds a package labeled 'Blueberry Cheese'. She tears the plastic wrapper open with her fingers. Her nails are long and manicured with a light color. (5) The scene shifts to a POV shot of a white microwave. The woman places a white bowl containing a single bagel inside. Her hand enters the frame to turn the black timer dial on the right side of the microwave unit. (6) Back to the medium shot, she takes the heated bagel and tears it in half with both hands. The camera zooms in to show the purple blueberry and cream cheese filling inside the bread. She takes a bite, her eyes widening in a positive reaction, and she nods repeatedly. (7) She continues to display different flavors, holding up three packages at once. Text icons for calories (108, 120) appear next to the specific bags. The camera uses jump cuts to transition between showing different labels and her speaking. (8) Another close-up features a cheese-crusted bagel. She tears it slowly, showcasing the melting cheese cubes inside the dough. The visual focus is sharp on the texture of the bread. (9) The woman returns to holding her phone, pointing at the screen while several bagel packs are stacked in front of her on a table. She looks happy and energetic. (10) The video ends with a full-screen graphic showing the brand logo, '減醣市集', and several product images with a five-star rating and promotional text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, energetic female voice narrates in Mandarin Chinese with a bright, friendly tone. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a persistent 4/4 drum machine beat. High-frequency synthesizer melodies accompany the vocal. Sharp 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used for visual emphasis as text appears. (2) A clear mechanical 'thud' signifies a microwave door closing, followed by the percussive 'click-click-click' of a rotating mechanical dial. The music remains steady in volume beneath these effects. The narrator's speech rate is moderately fast, conveying excitement. (3) The crisp sound of crinkling plastic packaging and the soft, fibrous tearing of bread are audible. The music continues its high-energy loop. The voice exhibits a rising intonation and high arousal as she reacts to the food. Digital 'ding' sounds punctuate the end of the promotional segment as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Benefits Analysis -> Sensory Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for a specific brand of low-carb bagels. It uses a high-information density approach, combining personal testimony with quantitative nutritional data (calories, protein) to appeal to health-conscious consumers. The narrative logic moves from establishing the problem (desire for bread vs. diet) to providing the solution with emotional and visual proof.
